name: dsh-tool-computer
description: Computer use for DeepSeek Harness: browser control over CDP and Windows desktop control with vision.
//: Do NOT run npm install or pnpm install in this folder. The plugin has no dependencies and must stay that way. npm drops a package-lock.json and a node_modules here, and a later `npm install <anything>` deletes the type:module line, after which Node reads index.js as CommonJS and the plugin refuses to load with "Unexpected token 'export'". Check it with: node ../../scripts/schema-guard.mjs
